comparison_panels.title: ProteinGym v1.3: Structure & MSA
comparison_panels.source_locator: Summary_performance_DMS_substitutions_Spearman.csv: all rows with Model type='Structure & MSA' and 217 available assay metrics; Average_Spearman column
comparison_panels.context: Zero-shot substitution fitness ranking on the same 217-assay reference. Assay Spearman rounded to 3 decimals; mean assays per UniProt ID and selection type; mean proteins within each selection type; equal mean of the 5 selection types; final value rounded to 3 decimals.
caveats: Reported input class: Structure & MSA. Other input classes are displayed separately; pretraining data and inference budgets are not controlled.
Source checking and arithmetic reaggregation are not independent model reproduction.
Configuration names are retained verbatim; exact checkpoint revisions and family equivalence are unextracted.
The source bootstrap standard error concerns differences from its top model, not absolute-score uncertainty; no error bars are inferred.
Protriever has only 200 nonmissing assay metrics and is retained as a separate result rather than inserted into the complete-coverage comparison.
This batch extracts every overall Mean Spearman cell. Function, MSA-depth, taxon and mutation-depth columns remain deferred.
